idea-plugin.name: SeleniumIQ - Selenium Test Automation Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
SeleniumIQ — Selenium WebDriver helpers for Java tests

Heuristic, offline tooling for Selenium WebDriver tests written in Java: stable-locator suggestions, locator repair, flaky-test pattern detection, inspections and code generators. No network services or machine-learning models are involved — every check is a deterministic rule you can read in the source.

Locators

  • Generate Locator (Ctrl+Alt+L) — ranked locator suggestions (data-testid, id, name, CSS, XPath) with a stability score
  • Heal Broken Locators — proposes more stable replacements for the selected locator
  • Locator stability annotations — inline warnings for fragile locators (absolute XPath, generated ids, indexes)

Test quality

  • Analyze Test Flakiness — scores a test method by flaky patterns (Thread.sleep, hard-coded waits, missing waits, brittle locators)
  • Inspections — flaky test patterns, brittle locators and Thread.sleep() in Selenium tests
  • Completion — WebDriver / By API entries

Code generation

  • Generate Page Object — from a page URL (fetched with Jsoup) or as a template, with @FindBy fields
  • Generate Test Template — a JUnit 5, JUnit 4 or TestNG Selenium test skeleton
  • Cloud Platform Setup — RemoteWebDriver starter class for BrowserStack, Sauce Labs or LambdaTest (copied to the clipboard)
  • Test Management Integration — TestNG listener skeleton for Jira or TestRail (copied to the clipboard)

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ with Java support
  • Selenium WebDriver in your project dependencies

Support

  • Source: github.com/JirakJ/selenium-iq-plugin
  • Issues: GitHub Issues
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.9.1

  • Renamed to "SeleniumIQ - Selenium Test Automation Toolkit"; the plugin has no AI or machine-learning component, all checks are deterministic rules.
  • Removed the remaining "AI" wording from the Generate Locator popup and dialog titles.

2026.9.0

  • Locator stability annotations apply only to By.* locator arguments.
  • Generate Test Template now generates a JUnit 5 / JUnit 4 / TestNG class; Cloud Platform Setup and Test Management Integration really copy code.
  • Brittle-locator inspection detects real id selectors.
  • Removed features that only displayed sample data, the empty settings page and a no-op quick fix.

2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/selenium-iq-plugin
